name: 1Password
jobs: account recovery when you forget the master password
verdict_reason: Vaultwarden runs beautifully — we timed it — and the math still never breaks even: at $20/h your maintenance minutes cost more than the subscription. The stakes are every password you own; keep paying, or use Bitwarden's free tier.
what_you_lose: Vendor-side recovery: self-hosted, a forgotten master password or a dead unbacked-up disk is game over, and nobody is awake at 3am for you
Someone else being legally on the hook for the sync layer

what_broke: Nothing during setup — the danger is entirely in year two: unattended, unpatched, unbacked-up
SIGNUPS_ALLOWED defaults leave registration open; flip it off after creating your account or you're running a free vault for strangers

notes: This is the site's thesis in one page: 'can you' is a resounding yes, 'should you' is a no for most people. If the subscription must go, Bitwarden's free hosted tier escapes the invoice without inheriting the pager.
